name: company-kernel
description: Run a lean decision kernel: system judgment, project truth, execution, evidence, and cold-path review.

interface.shortDescription: System judgment, project truth, work that learns
interface.longDescription: Install compact Coding, Product, and GTM standards above projects; keep current project models inside repositories; and invoke external review only when qualified evidence challenges the system or project.
defaultPrompt: Use $kernel-integrate for first setup, migration, shared-kernel changes, or capability reconciliation.
Use $project-model when durable technical, product, or market truth changes.
Use $kernel-review when qualified evidence may require changing a system standard or project model.
